ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white/cream pixels vs 15% low-intensity black and dark grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central region; continuous low-intensity black band along the trailing edge and perimeter; localized region of low-contrast yellow/tan staining at the bottom-central peduncle attachment area; high-contrast dark clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression; interior angle measured at approximately 45-50 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is high.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the full trailing edge boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 5 to 15 pixels; serration density is highest on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves tapering from the median notch to narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density dark pixel clusters at both lobe tips (barnacle colonization); sparse distribution of individual 5-10 pixel diameter circular dark pits scattered across the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical low-contrast linear pixel disruptions visible on the surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive protruding bio-encrustations at the lateral extremities of both lobes; one distinct reddish-brown focal lesion located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy three-dimensional silhouette distortion at the fluke tips due to dense cluster accumulation.
